2608.04457.title: Eigenius: A Typed Knowledge-Graph DBMS with Epistemic Stratification and Institution-Mediated Reasoning
2608.04457.paper_summary: As "AI Scientists" emerge to drive research via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), systems relying on ephemeral scripts will fail. The sheer scale of stateful, interconnected evidence requires a machine-walkable warranty grounded in a purpose-built database architecture. Eigenius is an open-source, typed knowledge-graph DBMS built on a single premise: answering the audit question ("what do you know, and what is your warranty?") requires a unified kernel. By tightly coupling the type system, storage engine, and integration protocol, Eigenius turns data provenance into a structural invariant rather than a property reconstructed across subsystem boundaries. The kernel rests on three pillars: a dependent type theory woven through the core, institutions acting as strongly typed integration boundaries, and a content-addressed immutable storage layer. On this foundation, epistemic status (declared/observed/derived/verified) is enforced as a strict commit-time invariant. Cross-system translations (comorphisms) are checked at commit and materialized directly into the graph as durable, first-class resources. To eliminate O(N^2) polystore bottlenecks, shared on-chain intermediate representations (IRs) collapse multi-system translations to identity. Crucially, this architecture unifies both domains of scientific epistemology: it relies on justification logic for empirical science, while embedding a fast, in-process term checker to safely evaluate formal mathematical proofs (via Lean 4) without IPC overhead. In an end-to-end recomputation of a published Nature study from fragile scripts to a materialized evidence graph, all 52 derived conclusions hold from pinned data, surfacing four machine-checked discrepancies in the original study.
2608.04457.paper_summary_zh: 隨著「AI 科學家」的出現，通過模型上下文協議（MCP）推動研究，依賴短暫腳本的系統將會失敗。狀態化的、互聯的證據的龐大規模需要一個基於專用數據庫架構的機器可行保證。Eigenius 是一個開源的、類型化的知識圖譜數據庫管理系統，其建立在一個單一的前提上：回答審計問題（「你知道什麼，你的保證是什麼？」）需要一個統一的核心。通過緊密耦合類型系統、存儲引擎和集成協議，Eigenius 將數據來源轉變為結構不變量，而不是跨子系統邊界重建的屬性。該核心建立在三個支柱上：一個編織於核心的依賴類型理論、作為強類型集成邊界的機構，以及一個內容地址的不變存儲層。在這一基礎上，認識狀態（聲明/觀察/推導/驗證）被強制執行為嚴格的提交時間不變量。跨系統翻譯（同態）在提交時進行檢查，並直接在圖中實現為持久的、一級資源。為了消除 O(N^2) 的多存儲瓶頸，共享的鏈上中間表示（IRs）將多系統翻譯簡化為身份。至關重要的是，這一架構統一了科學認識論的兩個領域：它依賴於實證科學的證明邏輯，同時嵌入了一個快速的、進程內的術語檢查器，以安全地評估正式數學證明（通過 Lean 4），而不產生進程間通訊的開銷。在對一項已發表的《自然》研究的端到端重新計算中，從脆弱的腳本到物化的證據圖，所有 52 個推導結論均基於固定數據，並揭示了原始研究中的四個機器檢查的不一致之處。
